personal.name: Md. Habibullah Pappu
personal.title: Network Engineer & System Specialist
personal.bio: Through my journey, I have encountered lots of opportunities to experience and gather knowledge in networking, system and security domain. Now I am seeking new challenges and opportunities with an organization in need of someone similar to my skill sets and suitable for long term career goals.

responsibilities: Lead planning, design, and management of Core Network and System Operations to ensure high availability, reliability, security, and optimal performance
Manage integration and connectivity with IIG, NTTN, IX, CDN, cache platforms, upstream providers, and third-party network partners
Collaborate with cross-functional teams to implement secure, scalable, and high-performance network solutions aligned with requirements
Prepare technical proposals, capacity plans, project documentation, management reports, and budget requirements for infrastructure development
Drive continuous improvement initiatives to enhance network resilience, service availability, operational efficiency, and infrastructure scalability
Plan, design, and manage the integration of connectivity with multiple stakeholders, including upstream providers, telecom operators, banks, vendors, IXN partners, and third-party entities
Responsible for seamless internet and data connectivity by leveraging Routing & Switching technologies
Supervised a 24/7 core network operations team, serving as the primary escalation point during outages
Analyze client requirements, coordinate with vendors and stakeholders, and support managed service operations teams
End-to-end nationwide network management, integration of connectivity with IIGs, IXNs and third-party entities
Maintain cache servers (GGC, FNA) for efficient content delivery
Manage Inter-AS IX peering for with IXP partners for local traffic
Conducting RNDs and evaluation objectives translation into action plans

Manage and maintain routing policy and Partner provisioning for NovoNIX ASN 63520 (Internet exchange point)

Planning, tuning and implement routing, controlling prefixes to meet optimization

Monitoring live Data & SDH network, Bandwidth utilization, transmission network distribution over IPLC and Alarms
Configuring soft switches, regular health checkup of core devices
Monitoring live Data & SDH network, Bandwidth utilization, transmission network distribution over IPLC and Alarms
Configuring soft switches and MUX maintenance
Making course plan along with lesson plan and take steps to ensure academic progress
Working on student's development, promote their learning and student management
Implementing blended learning using MOODLE and Google Classroom
